I provide analytical, spatial, and research expertise to support evidence-based decision-making in public health, humanitarian, and development contexts. My consultancy work focuses on data management, geographic analysis, impact evaluation, and technical research support.

## How I can help

```{=html}
<ul class="services">
  <li>Upskilling teams in geospatial analysis</li>
  <li>Designing and conducting quantitative or mixed methods research</li>
  <li>Data analysis for research and public health projects</li>
  <li>Building interactive dashboards to communicate research findings and other data</li>
</ul>
```
